Albino changes newly authored pigment and material response only: warm pearl-ivory and pale gray-beige shell, cool blue-gray recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe subsurface tissues, muted tan/ivory spine hooks, pale parasites and moist highlights; never pure flat white, glow, ice or an automatic recolor. Preserve strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile, a coherent all-clip scale target, dorsal load-bearing silhouette and idle/move/attack/death/release topology. Inter-clip scale and physical roots both require new measured reviews before acceptance. enemy-064-albino-carrier.continuityDecision: The reviewed V66 enemy-012-carrier lock and retained AvP Extinction bestiary crop control the base Carrier silhouette and back-carried parasite behavior. The official 20th Century Studios Alien vs. Predator page is used only as franchise-continuity context and does not establish this game caste. No reviewed primary or licensed source establishes this queue's Albino Carrier as a distinct official model; the pale material treatment is an original Tantalus Frontier systemic adaptation.

designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the V66 Carrier: long compressed dome, tall functional bipedal frame, narrow ribbed torso, clawed arms, digitigrade legs, exactly one segmented tail and the same stable fan of long upward/outward parasite-carrying dorsal spines with hooked tips.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale gray-beige shell, cool blue-gray recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe tissues, muted tan/ivory spine hooks, pale carried parasites, moist highlights and metallic silver/ivory teeth.
designDetails.surface: Pale biomechanical ribs, shell seams, load-bearing spine roots and parasite contacts remain readable through material/value contrast. The albino material is newly authored rather than a filtered, recolored or copied base bitmap.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless compressed domed head with double jaw, one narrow ribbed torso, two arms, two digitigrade legs, one stable array of long carrying spines, visible carried facehugger-scale parasites and exactly one continuous articulated tail.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 40 poses; head, limbs, carrying spines, carried parasites and complete tail stay inside their cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Inherit enemy-012's final pack scale 0.528301887 and source multiplier 1.000000 for idle, move, attack, death and release. Compare dome, thorax and pelvis landmarks, never the changing tail, dorsal-spine tips or released parasite reach.
designDetails.root: Use a stable pelvis/proximal-leg root projected to the supporting floor across all clips. Because enemy-012's physicalAnchorReview is pending, the generated candidate cannot pass acceptance until all 40 roots and support floors are physically reviewed.
designDetails.release: Eight chronological poses show brace, dorsal spine articulation, one staged parasite detachment, separation and host recovery. The Carrier remains the same body; no mouth emergence, anatomy replacement or unrelated morph.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scene, hive resin, text, logo or grid.
